CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

7. A — Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Red, blue, and yellow

11. B — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
